findings.passage: A clear national standard for voter ID with free, accessible verification
findings.note: On the Civic and Election Reform section of her campaign policy page, listed under 'I support:'. Page is undated; copied from the page text on 2026-10-22. It is a list item, not a full sentence. Page text does not say which documents count, or what happens to a voter without ID.

findings.passage: America’s democracy should be accessible to every eligible citizen, not just the well-funded or politically connected.
findings.note: Opening line of the same Civic and Election Reform section, which also lists a ban on foreign influence and dark money in elections. Context for the voter ID item.
subjects: access to voting for eligible citizens
